verdict.rationale: Letta Code explicitly documents a headless mode designed for non-interactive use in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, plus an --ephemeral flag for one-shot tasks without persisting state, and a self-hosted App Server exposing an OpenAI-compatible API for automation integration. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of actual CI usage or example CI config, and no third-party corroboration beyond vendor docs.
